case_studies_these_case_study.question: Are these case study results real?
case_studies_these_case_study.answer: Yes. Every figure comes from client Search Console, GA4 and CRM data, with baselines recorded before work started. Client names are withheld where permission was not granted.

case_studies_long_before_i.question: How long before I see results like these?
case_studies_long_before_i.answer: Technical and on-page gains typically show within 30-60 days, ranking movement in 60-90 days, and compounding traffic or revenue growth from month four onward.

case_studies_have_case_studies.question: Do you have case studies in my industry?
case_studies_have_case_studies.answer: We document e-commerce, SaaS, healthcare, legal, real estate and manufacturing here, and have delivered work in startups, education, travel, fashion and finance. Ask for relevant references.

case_studies_was_typical_budget.question: What was the typical budget for these projects?
case_studies_was_typical_budget.answer: Engagements are tailored to project scope and competitiveness, typically scaling with content volume, location breadth, and technical complexity.

case_studies_did_any_these.question: Did any of these clients get penalised later?
case_studies_did_any_these.answer: No. All work is manual and compliant with search engine spam policies, so gains have held through subsequent Google core updates.

case_studies_track_ai_assistant.question: How do you track AI assistant citations?
case_studies_track_ai_assistant.answer: We run a fixed monthly prompt set across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI Overviews, logging whether the brand is named, linked or omitted.

case_studies_guarantee_same_results.question: Can you guarantee the same results for me?
case_studies_guarantee_same_results.answer: No agency can guarantee specific rankings or revenue. We guarantee the method, the deliverables and transparent reporting against baselines we agree upfront.

case_studies_work_with_small.question: Do you work with small budgets?
case_studies_work_with_small.answer: Yes. We design customized plans for single-location businesses who need local visibility as well as enterprise campaigns.

case_studies_will_show_my.question: Will you show my business as a case study?
case_studies_will_show_my.answer: Only with your written permission, and we can anonymise the brand while keeping verified metrics.

case_studies_i_start_project.question: How do I start a project like these?
case_studies_i_start_project.answer: Request an audit on the contact page. We benchmark your site against competitors and send priorities plus a tailored proposal within one business day.
